name: Muslim Wellness Foundation
mission: Muslim Wellness Foundation (MWF) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting healing and well-being in American Muslim communities through dialogue, education and training.
theoryOfChange: The Muslim Wellness Foundation, in collaboration with Sapelo Square, developed the 'Election Wellness: HOME' toolkit. This toolkit takes a holistic approach to wellness, covering seven wellness domains (Political, Emotional, Environmental, Spiritual, Financial, Social & Physical) and provides an overview of issues, articulates community concerns, offers suggestions to address those concerns, and includes reflection questions to guide individuals in building their own strategies. This demonstrates a structured approach to achieving desired outcomes within a specific program, aligning with a program strategy document or impact framework.
